mapper.select: SELECT id, title, file_name, file_path, file_size, doc_type, domain_category, chunk_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM documents ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, file_name, file_path, file_size, doc_type, domain_category, chunk_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (title, file_name, file_path, file_size, doc_type, domain_category, chunk_count, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{docType}, #{domainCategory}, #{chunkCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
